LanguageData.MessageFoodKuru: {PAWN_labelShort} has started exhibiting symptoms of Kuru after eating: {FOOD_labelShort}.
LanguageData.MessageHealedKuruLuciferium: Luciferium mechanites adapted to Kuru and removed it from {PAWN_labelShort}.
LanguageData.MessageHealedKuruNaturalCannibal: Kuru infection disappeared from {PAWN_labelShort} thanks to them being a natural cannibal.
LanguageData.MeatHumanDesc: Raw butchered flesh. Can be cooked into meals or eaten raw, although most humans dislike the idea. May be dangerous.
LanguageData.KuruOptions_baseKuruInfectionChance_tool: Different sources have different chances of spreading infection (eating Kuru-infected human has a very high chance, eating random human has a very, very low chance). This is a global setting that affects all of them.
LanguageData.KuruOptions_worldgenPawnsCanBeInfected_t: Any pawn which fulfills the criteria for having a chance of contracting Kuru can spawn already infected. This includes guests, traders, raids, etc.
LanguageData.KuruOptions_progressionSpeed: Speed of brain damage over time, roughly:
LanguageData.KuruOptions_butcherSkillMatters_tooltip: Cooking skill when butchering pawn matters and can prevent transmission.
LanguageData.KuruOptions_infectFromIdeologion_tooltip: Cultures practicing or permitting cannibalism, inherent chance.
LanguageData.KuruOptions_infectFromRecentIngestion_to: Pawns that recently ate human meat, inherent chance.
LanguageData.KuruOptions_infectFromTraits_tooltip: Pawns having the Cannibal trait, inherent chance.
LanguageData.KuruOptions_luciferiumCures_tooltip: Luciferium users will eventually be cured of Kuru. It might take a few days or a few years, based on brain damage speed setting. This setting also turns off luciferium addicts as vectors for Kuru disease—you cannot get Kuru by eating a luciferium addict. Default: ON.
LanguageData.KuruOptions_naturalCannibalCures_tooltip: Pawns with the Natural Cannibal gene will eventually be cured of Kuru; it might take a few days or a few years, based on brain damage speed setting. This setting also turns off pawns with the Natural Cannibal gene as vectors for Kuru disease—you cannot get Kuru by eating a pawn with the Natural Cannibal gene. Default: ON.
